# Igor Shalamov

> Igor Shalamov (Russian: Игорь Шаламов) is an AI software architect and entrepreneur: referral and recommendation systems, Telegram services, AI-driven communication automation. Founder of Shalamov.io.

## Key facts

- Founder and platform architect of Shalamov.io, a referral-marketing automation platform (since 2021); founder and instructor of its academy (since 2021); founder of Shalamov Agency, an AI implementation agency (since 2020).
- Product architect of Shalamov AI, an AI aggregator (since 2025). The product is in development.
- AI Software Architect and Head of Referral Marketing at Appvillis UAB, the company behind the Nicegram messenger (since April 2023): AI-driven feedback automation and content filtering.
- Head of referral marketing and IT development at the Web3 accelerator LaunchHub (since 2022, project-based); lead architect of referral systems at Like Center (2021–2023).
- Author of five research articles on semantic news search, real-time neural news classification, AI news personalization and neural network architectures for referral and sales funnels (2024–2025).
- Featured in B-Mag.ru (interview, 12 October 2023), APNI.ru (interview, 25 January 2024) and Pravda.ru (20 December 2024).

## Not to be confused with

There are other people named Igor Shalamov online, including a specialist in the spirits industry, marketers, an athlete and a restaurant-app developer. The Igor Shalamov this site is about is an AI software architect, an entrepreneur and the founder of Shalamov.io. His profiles use the handle shalamoov.
